summary: Frontend-only verification of the BeforeAfterMap visibility fix in the Account section. Seeded admin (Pro) with (1) only an eigenmode resonance_profile row, and (2) eigenmode + a newer non-eigenmode row. Navigated Dashboard → Account menu → Account view and confirmed the 'Before & after frequency map' card is always visible. Both scenarios pass all data-testid + copy/date-format assertions. Backend regression (baseline+latest=null vs baseline+latest populated) confirmed via API before UI checks. Seed data cleaned up.

navigation_path: Login → Dashboard loads (dismiss milestone celebration modals via 'Continue my journey') → header data-testid='account-button' → data-testid='account-menu-account' → scroll down to Harmonic Blueprint section → 'BEFORE & AFTER FREQUENCY MAP' card. Direct URL navigation to /account works but launches milestone celebrations first which must be dismissed. Not a bug, prior behaviour.
critical_code_review_comments: BeforeAfterMap.jsx duplicates the header markup (Sparkles + title) in the Frame component and inline in the populated branch (lines 100-107). Minor DRY nit — could wrap the populated branch in the Frame component too. Not a bug.

HarmonicBlueprintSection mounts <BeforeAfterMap /> only when `isPro && hasBaseline` (line ~191). Free users with a baseline will never see this card. If that's intentional (Pro-gated feature) it's fine; if not, gate should be reconsidered. Current fix scope is only about visibility for the Pro user path.
seed_data_creation: Used /app/scripts/seed_before_after.py which seeds resonance_profiles for admin then cleans. Post-test: `python /app/scripts/seed_before_after.py clean` executed — 0 residual test rows in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The BeforeAfterMap card is now always visible for Pro+baseline users via the shared Frame wrapper. To reproduce either state, use /app/scripts/seed_before_after.py with args 'eigen' (no-latest) / 'both' (populated) / 'clean'. Navigate via account-button → account-menu-account (URL /account alone leaves user on Dashboard until milestone modals are dismissed). Note that seeding an eigenmode triggers milestone celebration modals ('Your Harmonic Blueprint is set' + 'Deeply aligned with your natural tuning') that overlay the app — dismiss with 'Continue my journey' button before interacting with the account view.
